semiconductor_relevance: High — Fastmicro specializes in advanced surface particle contamination inspection equipment, which is critical for maintaining cleanliness in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Fastmicro BV is a leader in providing advanced surface particle contamination inspection equipment and scanners for the microtechnology industries. Their solutions focus on cost-effective contamination control at the (sub)microscale level, helping to reduce defects and yield losses in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Inline bare wafer defect inspection systems

regional_presence.Netherlands: Headquartered in the Brainport district of Eindhoven, Netherlands, Fastmicro has a strong local presence.
regional_presence.Taiwan: Fastmicro has local representation to support its operations in Taiwan.
regional_presence.Korea: Sales offices are established in Korea to cater to the local market.
regional_presence.Japan: Fastmicro maintains a presence in Japan for sales and support.
regional_presence.United States: The company has a sales office in the USA to serve North American customers.
